title: Which way does it go?
hook: A rapid body motion can push against water.

knows: Animals have body structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The second panel marks water pushed one way and the shrimp moving the opposite way. Many shrimp use rapid abdominal flexion for an escape response; the diagram is schematic and contains no measured speed.

misconception: The shrimp must move in the same direction as the water it pushes.
objective: In a toy model with no external horizontal forces, a freely swimming shrimp pushes water forward. Which way does its body move?

claims.text: A rapid body motion can push against water. In a toy model with no external horizontal forces, a freely swimming shrimp pushes water forward. Which way does its body move? The second panel marks water pushed one way and the shrimp moving the opposite way. Many shrimp use rapid abdominal flexion for an escape response; the diagram is schematic and contains no measured speed.

claims.text: Recall: In a toy model with no external horizontal forces, a shrimp pushes water to the right. Which way is its body shown moving? In the stipulated model, the body moves opposite the pushed water.
